Yes, Pan-European identity is a product of Christianity. But Christianity itself is just a religion. Not any ethno-religion. Not even native to Europe and has way more conflict and sectarianism within itself. Yes, Pan-European identity is a product of Christianity. But the nationhood and ingredients for it at a Pan-European level, do not exist within Europe. This is not the case with India and Indians. Again you are conflating nationstates with nations and civilizational nations. Nationstate itself is just a recent development in human history and emerged globally only after the Napoleonic Wars. But this doesn't means that India the nation and national identity never existed. It did. Read pre-British era Indian sources and writings on their own country and nationhood...
